Subject: Globex onboarding — org access gating & SSO/SCIM checklist

Hi Alex / Globex security team —

Thanks for the quick hand-raise on the integration. To make the staging cutover and initial production handoff smooth, we put together a short gating checklist focused on access controls (SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, IP allowlists, and service account patterns). I attached the working checklist; below are the specific asks we need to lock before we start provisioning tenant-level roles in staging: 

1) SSO / IdP
- IdP metadata XML or metadata URL (EntityID, SSO endpoint, certificate thumbprint)
- Which attributes do you plan to send (email, name, groups)? Any nonstandard claims?

2) SCIM provisioning
- SCIM base URL and a long-lived token (or OAuth client) for provisioning; indicate whether token is scoped to a single org
- Expected provisioning cadence and primary keys (email vs externalId)

3) Network allowlist
- IP ranges for production and staging outbound traffic (CIDR) so we can request egress rules on your firewall

4) Service accounts & org policies
- List of service accounts that need API-level roles and the minimal RBAC required (e.g., "svc-data-sync@globex: read-only embeddings")
- Any org-level policies we should enforce (auto-provisioning disabled, SSO-enforced for admins, retention windows).

5) Evidence & timeline
- If you need SOC2 / pen test artifacts for security review, say the word and we’ll get them to Contracts.
- Proposed kickoff windows for staging provisioning (please suggest a 2-hour slot next week).

Owners: Ben will own SCIM and service-account provisioning from our side; Priyom will coordinate the SSO metadata and IP allowlist validation. Monica will track the mutual action plan and HubSpot milestones.

Proposed times (PDT): Tue 24 Jul 10:00–12:00, Wed 25 Jul 14:00–16:00. Tell us what works and we’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Globex into staging.

—

Kimberly — thanks for the clear list. A few clarifications from our side before the kickoff:

- Service account naming: we need an example naming convention we can sign-off on (we try to avoid revealing environment in the name).
- IP allowlist: our network team asked whether Redwood supports dynamic egress CIDRs (we rotate a /24 quarterly) or if you require a fixed set.
- Evidence: Contracts would like a copy of your SOC2 report and last pen-test summary to attach to our procurement packet.

Alex — quick answers inline and a couple of notes: 

- "Can Redwood accept per-tenant scoped SCIM tokens?" — Yes. Our onboarding runtime supports per-tenant API tokens scoped to a single organization. We recommend issuing a token per environment (staging/prod) and rotating every 90 days. We can accept either a static token or an OAuth client credential flow; if you want automated rotation, go with OAuth.

- Service account naming convention (suggested): rbw-svc-<service>-<tenant-hash>-role (example: rbw-svc-embsync-4f2b-admin). This avoids exposing environment and gives us a stable alias to map in audit logs. If Globex has a preferred canonical ID mapping, we’ll honor it.

- IP allowlist behavior: Redwood supports fixed CIDR allowlists on a per-tenant basis. If your team rotates egress ranges quarterly, we can accept a managed allowlist entry with an "anticipated rotation" note, and we’ll schedule a revalidation window 7 days prior to rotation. For production, we recommend a fixed announced range + short maintenance windows for rotation.

- Evidence: SOC2 Type II report and the latest pen-test exec summary are attached; I’ve shared a Contracts-friendly copy with the Contracts alias.

Next steps I’ve taken: uploaded a pre-provisioning runbook and filled the SCIM token section in the checklist with the OAuth option as preferred. I attached the updated checklist (redwood-access-checklist.xlsx) and a link to the onboarding runbook.

Proposed owners and due dates:
- Globex to provide IdP metadata and SCIM token: due Wed 25 Jul EOD (Alex)
- Redwood to provision staging tenant and create per-tenant tokens: due Thu 26 Jul EOD (Ben)
- Network allowlist confirmation from Globex: due Wed 25 Jul EOD (Alex / network)

I’ll plan to provision a staging tenant once we have the metadata + token. Happy to demo the provisioning flow during the Wed sync.
